source: Eldenpedia (eldenring.wiki.gg) for graces, crones, stranded souls, sword monuments and base-game summoning pools; Fextralife for crone locations, effigies of the martyr and monument cross-checks; Internet Archive snapshots for Birdseye Telescopes and, for gap verification, Stakes of Marika where live pages are missing.

notes.idScheme: category-region-name, lowercased ASCII slugs; numeric suffix on collision.
notes.regionGrouping: Regions follow the wiki.gg grace-page grouping. Weeping Peninsula and Mt. Gelmir are subregions of Limgrave and Altus Plateau there, even though they are separate labels on the in-game map.
notes.unnamedSouls: Stranded Souls have no canonical names; they are labelled 'Stranded Soul — <location>' and the location/dialogue fields carry the source text.
notes.routeStepId: Only linked when a route step's link label matches the grace name after case/punctuation normalization and the step text mentions a grace; otherwise empty.

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Stranded Graveyard
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Brave Tarnished. Take the plunge. Of learning, and remembrance. Recall the arts of war. And your warrior's blood."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Stormfoot Catacombs
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "A proper death means returning to the Erdtree. Have patience. Until the time comes…and the roots call to you."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Church of Pilgrimage
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "The mausoleum prowls. Cradling the soulless demigod. O Marika, Queen Eternal. He is your unwanted child."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Limgrave, overlooking Mistwood
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "O Sapling! Sweet sapling of glorious gold. Has your crystal teardrop ripened?"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Death-Touched Catacombs
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Unthinkable. Our hallowed resting place is violated. To refuse the Erdtree's call to return, to live within Death… Sickening."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Mistwood, near Fort Haight
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "The demi-humans wax wroth, now their mother's been taken… Where are you, Lord Kenneth? The knight…bedeviled by blood."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Castle Morne
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Please, help me. I'm of noble blood. If those hideous mongrels eat me, I'll be forever marred… Anything but that, please! Think of the disgrace!"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Limgrave Colosseum
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "All I wanted was to fight. To fight, as a warrior, to the last… So, why? Why, O guidance of grace, will this door not open?" Removed in patch 1.08; the ghost is no longer present in-game.

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Stormveil Castle, past throne room
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Maiden, dear maiden, where are you? Please, take my grapes."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Weeping Peninsula, near the Fourth Church of Marika
entries.location: Weeping Peninsula, near the Fourth Church of Marika
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Ohh, there it is, the tower! Finally, I can return. To our home, bathed in rays of gold!"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Albinauric Village
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "This village is done for. Please, even if it's just you, old Albus, hide well and still your breath."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Frenzied Flame Village
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Ahh, Lord Vyke, it seems that you were no lord, after all. Then where is he? Our true Lord, our Lord of Frenzied Flame. We beg of you, incinerate all that divides and distinguis..."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Liurnia Highway North
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Ahh, the puppets… The puppets besiege us…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Near the Gate Town Bridge
entries.location: Near the Gate Town Bridge Site of Grace
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Raya Lucaria, hallowed hall dedicated to the study of magic. Why shut your doors to me? Am I barred from donning the crown of stone?"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Kingsrealm Ruins
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Ahh, Iji, forgive me. These royal grounds were placed in our trust, but we stood no chance."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Carian Study Hall
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "O Celestial Globe, transmit to posterity. The wisdom of the moon and stars. And obscure, forever, the transgressions of the princess."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Carian Manor
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Lady Ranni, we have long awaited you. I pray for your house's swift revival. May the full moon shine upon Caria."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Purified Ruins
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Come out, one and all, from the darkness underground. And let us offer unto the maiden our eyes."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Near Revenger's Shack
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Ahh, the poor fellow…gone perfectly mad. Love…revenge…the frenzied flame melts it all away…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Grand Lift of Dectus
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "It's there, somewhere. Another path, leading back to the foot of the Erdtree. An ancient tunnel."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Dominula, Windmill Village
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Eek… I hear a festive melody… No, no, don't skin me… My hide is filthy, I swear…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Near Altus Highway Junction
entries.location: Near Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Ohh, Erdtree, great Erdtree. The Golden Order itself, unwavering, stretched to the sky. Confer your guidance. To our Elden Lord. To put this weary world to rights…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Near the entrance to Volcano Manor
entries.location: Near the entrance to Volcano Manor
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Lord Rykard… If this putrid field of death is what your blasphemy would bring, then I can no longer abide. No one can."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Shaded Castle
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "House Marais is ruined… Just deserts, for falling for that severed harpy. No surprise that guilty cretin took the castle and our storied sword…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Fort Laiedd
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Eek…! The wretched fools… They'll never find me. Heh heh… I'll survive, I swear it. I'll soon be back at the Volcano Manor."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — East of Smouldering Wall
entries.location: East of Smouldering Wall Site of Grace
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Sublime, I tell you. The very first flower of Aeonia bloomed on this very spot. Malenia, may you blossom into a goddess."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Fort Gael
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Convene the festival of war. Honor General Radahn, with a warrior's glory. It's in your hands, Sir Jerren…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — East of Aeonia Swamp Shore
entries.location: East of Aeonia Swamp Shore Site of Grace
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Let me see it, if only one last time. Your splendid blade, dancing amongst the scarlet rot."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Dragonbarrow, near Divine Tower of Caelid
entries.location: Dragonbarrow, near Divine Tower of Caelid
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "I'm dry, dry as a bone… Fool dragon, surrender your strength. Let me feast on your heart."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Rotview Balcony
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "It's rotting. Everything, rotting scarlet. The very earth that Caelid rests upon, and Sellia, town of sorcery. The end is nigh, for us all."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Castle Sol, Church of the Eclipse
entries.location: Castle Sol, Church of the Eclipse
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Ohh great sun! Frigid sun of Sol! Surrender yourself to the eclipse! Grant life to the soulless bones!"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — After Castle Sol Rooftop
entries.location: After Castle Sol Rooftop Site of Grace
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Lord Miquella, forgive me. The sun has not been swallowed. Our prayers were lacking. Your comrade remains soulless… I will never set my eyes upon it now… Your divine Haligtree…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Start of Consecrated Snowfield
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Show me the path, O gentle lights. The promised path to the Haligtree!"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — West of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
entries.location: West of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "… Only… a little further now… Show me the path, O gentle lights… the path to Elphael."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Consecrated Snowfield, pointing towards the location of...
entries.location: Consecrated Snowfield, pointing towards the location of the teleporter leading to Mohgwyn Palace
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Mohg, you rotten Omen. Your blood is cursed. Give him back. Give Lord Miquella back! How dare you lay hands on such precious flesh!"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Siofra River, after Mimic Tear
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Lord of Blood, your eminence. I beg you, grant me a seat at the table of the dynasty. Long live the Mohgwyn Dynasty. Long live! The Mohgwyn Dynasty!"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Near Leyndell, Capital of Ash
entries.location: Near Leyndell, Capital of Ash Site of Grace
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "Behold. The Erdtree yet stands. Tall and unwavering, mindless of the scorch of the flame of ruin. Hahah, Hahah… Then, we are yet Golden Ones."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Near the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace after killing...
entries.location: Near the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace after killing Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "He is returned! The Lord has returned at long last. Our very first lord, to brandish the Elden Ring once more…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Abandoned Ailing Village
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "… Oh, how it hurts…from very tip to toe… Aaah… Nnngh… Help me, I must ask… Am I human still? Is that the reason…I yet suffer so?"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Scorched Ruins
entries.location: Outside of the Scorched Ruins in Gravesite Plain
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "… Ev'ryone…burned to cinders…burned away. Put to the torch…by Messmer…and his lot. What did we do to deserve such a fate? We merely lived our lives… We lived in peace…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Northeast of Scorched Ruins
entries.location: At the foot of a tree to the northeast of the Scorched Ruins in Gravesite Plain
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "… I know… All your resentment lingers yet… The raw stuff from which I shall surely forge a curse. Upon the dastard Messmer's head. Upon Marika's children each and all."

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Ellac River Downstream
entries.location: Ellac River Downstream site of grace.
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "… I was once told a coffin could convey… Its passenger upon a gentle cruise… To the velvet garden of deepest purple. Oh…to slumber in such a paradise…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Ruined Forge Lava Intake
entries.location: Found at the Ruined Forge Lava Intake dungeon.
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "… By Grace, if e'er I see another rock… I shall find it, of this I have no doubt. The altar of the forge cannot be far…"

entries.name: Stranded Soul — Belurat Gaol
entries.description: Dialogue excerpt: "… Oh please. Not the jar… Anything but that! I promise. I won't ever do it again! I swear—a living saint I'll surely be! Please…you must forgive me. Forgive me, please."

entries.name: The War against the Giants
entries.location: Near the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, in Mountaintops of the Giants
entries.description: Inscription: "The War against the Giants / Champions battle, trolls betray / Fire vanquished, the era of the Erdtree begins"

entries.name: The Routing of the Ancient Dragons
entries.location: Next to the Stormcaller Church, in Altus Plateau
entries.description: Inscription: "The Routing of the Ancient Dragons / Godwyn the Golden fought to the last, / Earning the friendship of dread Fortissax"

entries.name: The First Liurnian War
entries.location: Near the Bellum Church, in Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.description: Inscription: "The First Liurnian War / Radagon 's glory burns red as his hair"

entries.name: The Second Liurnian War
entries.location: Near the Church of Vows, in Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.description: Inscription: "The Second Liurnian War / No victory for the golden, nor for the moon / No prize but atonement; the birth of a vow"

entries.name: The siege of Castle Morne
entries.location: Left of the entrance to Castle Morne, in the Weeping Peninsula
entries.description: Inscription: "The siege of Castle Morne / A lone hero fights for his vengeance / Only to fall at the hand of Lord Godfrey"

entries.name: Lord Godfrey, at last at the end of his campaign
entries.location: Near the Smoldering Church in Limgrave, on the border of Caelid
entries.description: Inscription: "His golden armies unvanquished and unbowed / Yet finds grace lost, tattered and faded"

entries.name: The resting place of the contemptible Cuckoos
entries.location: Outside Caria Manor, in Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.description: Inscription: "The resting place of the contemptible Cuckoos / Lost in the siege of Caria Manor"

entries.name: The Starscourge Conflict
entries.location: Near the Impassable Greatbridge Site of Grace, in Caelid
entries.description: Inscription: "The Starscourge Conflict / Radahn alone holds Sellia secure / And stands tall, to shatter the stars"

entries.name: The First Defense of Leyndell
entries.location: On the cliff above Second Church of Marika, in Altus Plateau
entries.description: Inscription: "The First Defense of Leyndell / A sovereign alliance rots from within / Traces yet remain of bloody conspiracy"

entries.name: The Second Defense of Leyndell
entries.location: Near the Outer Wall Battleground Site of Grace in the Capital Outskirts, in Altus Plateau
entries.description: Inscription: "The Second Defense of Leyndell / The Fell Omen stacks high the corpses of heroes / Yet the Erdtree remains unshaken"

entries.name: The Assault on Volcano Manor
entries.location: Near the Ninth Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, in Mt. Gelmir
entries.description: Inscription: "The Assault on Volcano Manor / The squalid, the sick, the blasphemous; / a wretched, unending war with no glory"

entries.name: This marks Malenia's southward march
entries.location: Near the Liurnia Highway North Site of Grace, in Liurnia of the Lakes
entries.description: Inscription: "This marks Malenia's southward march / The Blade of Miquella and her Cleanrot Knights / Grant her wings never to be clipped"

entries.name: Godrick the Golden, humiliated
entries.location: Next to the Agheel Lake North Site of Grace, in Limgrave
entries.description: Inscription: "Godrick the Golden, humiliated / Having tasted defeat by the Blade of Miquella / Now on his knees, begging for mercy"

entries.name: The Battle of Aeonia
entries.location: Near the Astray from Caelid Highway North Site of Grace, in Caelid
entries.description: Inscription: "The Battle of Aeonia / Radahn and Malenia locked in stalemate / Then, the scarlet rot blooms"

grace.note: wiki.gg lists 313 base rows and 105 Shadow of the Erdtree rows. 5 Leyndell graces are listed twice (Royal Capital and Ashen Capital) and were collapsed; the two Artist's Shack graces are distinct objects in different regions and are both kept.

finger-reader.note: The wiki.gg Finger Reader Crone page is a stub with no location list. Fextralife enumerates 8 crone locations; the named Finger Reader Enia (wiki.gg) is added separately. Neither source claims the list is exhaustive and neither covers the DLC.

stranded-soul.note: wiki.gg documents 38 base-game spirits and 18 DLC spirits. 12 DLC rows give only a screenshot (no text location) and are omitted rather than guessed; the page does not claim the table is exhaustive.

sword-monument.note: wiki.gg table with inscription and location for all 14 monuments; Fextralife states 'There are fourteen locations with hills of swords'.

stake-of-marika.note: No authoritative per-stake list exists in the permitted sources. wiki.gg's Stakes of Marika page is a stub; Fextralife lists only area names (e.g. 'Abandoned Cave', 'Caelid'), not individual stakes. No rows were generated.

martyr-effigy.note: Fextralife enumerates 157 base-game and 56 DLC effigies with descriptions and map markers, but states that some zone extents still need detail. wiki.gg's Summoning Pools page lists base-game pools only and does not cover the DLC, so the category is reported as partial.

birdseye-telescope.note: No live authoritative list: wiki.gg only has the tutorial item page and the live Fextralife 'Birdseye Telescopes'/'Martyr Effigies' pages are 404. Four base-game locations come from an Internet Archive snapshot of the Fandom object page; DLC telescopes are undocumented in these sources.

gatekeeper-statue.note: No Elden Ring object called 'Gatekeeper Statue' exists in wiki.gg or Fextralife. The wiki.gg search returns the NPC Gatekeeper Gostoc and no statue object; both Fextralife title variants return 404. No authoritative list, so no rows.

summoningPools.note: Wiki.gg's Summoning Pools page covers the base game only (154 gallery entries, 153 unique names) and is used as an independent lower bound for the 157 base-game effigies listed by Fextralife.

swordMonuments.fextralifeStatement: There are fourteen locations with hills of swords
swordMonuments.note: Both sources agree on fourteen sword monuments; no DLC monuments are listed.

gaps.detail: wiki.gg Stakes of Marika is a stub whose only 'Locations' value is 'Dungeons'. Fextralife lists areas that contain stakes, not the stakes themselves. Generating one row per area would misrepresent area names as world objects, so zero rows are emitted.

gaps.issue: object does not exist in any source
gaps.detail: No page or list uses the term 'Gatekeeper Statue'. The closest statues documented by the wikis are Effigies of the Martyr (summoning pools), Stakes of Marika, Rebirth Monuments and the Stonesword Key imp seals; none is called a gatekeeper statue. Treated as unresolved rather than mapped to a different object.
12 of 18 Shadow of the Erdtree rows show only a screenshot in the location column. They were skipped instead of assigning a guessed area.

gaps.issue: only a tertiary archived list exists
gaps.detail: Live Fextralife pages for 'Birdseye Telescopes' and 'Birdseye Telescope' are 404s; wiki.gg has only 'About Birdseye Telescopes' (no locations). Four base-game locations are taken from an archived Fandom page and flagged unresolved.
wiki.gg's page is a stub; Fextralife's 8 locations are the only enumeration and do not cover the DLC, so the category stays partial.
Fextralife says some effigy zone extents still need detail; wiki.gg covers base-game summoning pools only. Counts are reported as a lower bound, not a verified total.

5 Leyndell graces appear under both Leyndell, Royal Capital and Leyndell, Ashen Capital in the source. They are the same fast-travel points, so the Ashen listing is dropped and the overlap is recorded under meta.grace.collapsed.
